# Urban Genetics Atlas

Live Atlas: https://852lab.github.io/Urban-Genetics-Atlas/

Full public context: https://852lab.github.io/Urban-Genetics-Atlas/atlas-context.md

Public implementation:
- https://852lab.github.io/Urban-Genetics-Atlas/index.html
- https://852lab.github.io/Urban-Genetics-Atlas/atlas.js
- https://852lab.github.io/Urban-Genetics-Atlas/styles.css
- https://852lab.github.io/Urban-Genetics-Atlas/release-manifest.json

Review the live interface first, then the public context and implementation files.

Focus on:
- Urban Analysis
- Urban Genetic Signature (UGS)
- spatial fingerprints
- urban condition
- modelled change
- observed activity
- popup behaviour
- Urban Fabric controls
- desktop/mobile behaviour
- data limitations

Important: **UGS describes urban condition; it is not a redevelopment prediction.**

Current release: V1.4-20260903-205342
